questions.q: What does Greene say mastery requires?
questions.why: He states mastery must be maintained, not attained.

questions.q: How many ways does Greene suggest to handle power games?
questions.why: He lists three options: embrace, ignore, accept.

questions.q: What does Greene advise to escape tactical hell?
a: Zoom out for a long‑term view
questions.why: He recommends taking an elevated, big‑picture perspective.

questions.q: Which book launched Greene's writing career?
questions.why: His breakthrough was publishing The 48 Laws of Power.
